/.description: Mirembe Cleaning Company is a family-owned residential cleaning business preparing to serve Boston, MA, and Newington, CT. Join our waitlist for launch updates.
/.mainText: Launching January 2027 · Holiday bookings availableA Cleaner Home, More Peace.Trusted home and rental cleaning across Greater Hartford, CT, and Greater Boston, MA. Thoughtful, reliable cleaning designed to give you one less thing to worry about.Join the WaitlistRequest a Cleaning✓All Mirembe cleaners are background-checked, insured, and bonded.Home & rental cleaningGreater Boston, MAGreater Hartford, CTLooking for cleaning work? Join our teamMirembepeace · tranquilityHome & rental cleaningGreater Hartford, CTGreater Boston, MAThe meaning behind our nameMirembe Means Peace.In Ugandan Bantu languages, Mirembe means “peace” or “tranquility” — a hope for harmony, for one person and for the whole community.That’s what we want you to feel when you walk through your door: a calm, clean space and one less thing to worry about.Our storyBuilt With Care.Rooted in Family.Mirembe Cleaning Company was founded by a husband and wife who are homeowners, multifamily real estate investors, and landlords. Between caring for our own home, our family, and our rental properties, we saw how difficult it could be to find cleaning help that was reliable, efficient, and fairly priced.So we built the kind of cleaning company we wanted for ourselves.As a woman- and minority-owned family business serving Connecticut and Massachusetts, we treat every home with the same care we’d give our own. Whether it’s a rental between tenants, a busy family’s home, a parent who needs a little extra help, or someone experiencing health or mobility challenges, our goal is to make life a little easier.When you choose Mirembe, you’re not just hiring a cleaning company. You’re welcoming a family that cares.Our servicesCleaning designed around your home.Every clean follows our room-by-room checklist, so you know exactly what to expect.Standard CleanReliable weekly, biweekly, monthly, or one-time cleaning to keep your home fresh and comfortable.What’s IncludedDeep CleanA detailed top-to-bottom clean for first visits, seasonal resets, holiday hosting, or whenever your home needs extra attention.What’s IncludedRental Turnovers & Move-In/Move-OutThorough cleaning for landlords, property managers, tenants, and homeowners — helping properties become tenant-ready and photo-ready.What’s IncludedNot sure what you need? Request a Cleaning＋Available add-onsInside cabinetsDishesChoose add-ons when you book. Availability varies by service.How it worksBooking Mirembe is simple.Three simple steps — from choosing your clean to coming home to more peace.01Choose Your CleanSelect your service, home size, and any extras you need.02See Your Price & BookGet transparent pricing and choose a date that works for you.03Come Home to More PeaceOur trained team arrives with the supplies, follows the Mirembe checklist, and takes care of the rest.Join the WaitlistRequest a CleaningPeace begins at homeWhy families choose usWhy Mirembe?Six reasons homeowners, families, and landlords trust us with the places that matter most.Built by LandlordsWe understand what vacancies cost. Our founders are property owners too, so efficient, dependable rental turnovers matter to us.Safer ProductsCarefully selected eco-friendly cleaning products, with fragrance-free options available for sensitive households.Simple Pricing & BookingSee your price and book online in minutes, with the option to speak with us directly.A Team You Can TrustTrained, background-checked employees, insured and bonded. Whenever possible, we’ll send the same trusted cleaner back.Our Clean GuaranteeIf something isn’t right, let us know within 24 hours and we’ll return to re-clean the affected areas at no cost.Flexible SchedulingWeekday appointments, with weekend and holiday availability when needed.Where we serveCleaning services near home.Mirembe serves homes and rental properties across Greater Hartford, Connecticut, and Greater Boston, Massachusetts.CONNECTICUTGreater Hartford, ConnecticutHome and rental cleaning across Hartford and the surrounding towns of central Connecticut.HartfordNewingtonWest HartfordWethersfieldRocky HillNew BritainGlastonburyNearby TownsMASSACHUSETTSGreater Boston, MassachusettsHome and rental cleaning across Boston, its neighborhoods, and nearby communities.BostonDorchesterEverettCambridgeSomervilleMedfordMaldenQuincyNearby TownsDon’t see your town?Join the waitlist and let us know. We’re growing, and your request helps us decide where Mirembe goes next.Join the WaitlistA note from our foundersBuilt from our home to yours.As homeowners, landlords, and multifamily real estate investors, we’ve experienced firsthand how difficult it can be to find cleaning help that’s reliable, efficient, and fairly priced.Between caring for our own home, our family, and our rental properties, we knew there had to be a better way.So we decided to build the kind of cleaning company we’d want caring for our own home and properties. As a woman- and minority-owned family business serving Connecticut and Massachusetts, we believe every home deserves thoughtful, dependable care.Whether we’re helping a busy family, preparing a rental for its next tenant, or supporting someone who needs an extra hand, our goal remains the same: to make life feel a little easier.When you choose Mirembe, you’re not just hiring a cleaning company. You’re welcoming a family that cares.With care,Felix & BriaFounders, Mirembe Cleaning CompanyQuestionsFrequently asked questions.Everything you need to know before your first clean.When does Mirembe Cleaning Company open?We open for regular bookings in January 2027. We’re also accepting a limited number of holiday cleanings in November and December 2026.What areas do you serve?We serve Greater Hartford, Connecticut, and Greater Boston, Massachusetts, including the communities shown above. Join the waitlist if your town is not listed so we can keep you updated.What’s the difference between a Standard Clean and a Deep Clean?A Standard Clean keeps your home fresh and tidy. A Deep Clean includes detailed work like the inside of the oven, microwave, and fridge; baseboards; cabinet fronts; door frames; grout; ceiling fans; and blinds. We recommend a Deep Clean for your first visit or before a big gathering.What products do you use?We plan to use carefully selected eco-friendly cleaning products, with fragrance-free options for sensitive households. Let us know about any product preferences when booking.Do you bring your own supplies?Our team arrives with the supplies needed for your clean. If you have product preferences or a particular surface that needs special care, please tell us when booking.Are your cleaners insured and background-checked?Our cleaning team is planned to consist of trained, background-checked employees, with insurance and bonding for added peace of mind. Please confirm the current coverage and hiring details with us before booking.Do I need to be home during the cleaning?You can tell us your access preferences when booking. We’ll coordinate the details with you before your appointment.What if I’m not happy with my clean?Let us know within 24 hours if something was missed and we’ll return to re-clean the affected areas at no cost. We’ll confirm the guarantee terms before your appointment.What is your cancellation policy?Please contact us as early as possible if your plans change. We’ll confirm the cancellation terms and any applicable fees before your appointment.Do you clean on weekends and holidays?Weekday appointments are planned, with limited weekend and holiday availability when needed. Available times are confirmed during booking.Do you work with landlords and property managers?Yes. Our rental turnover and move-in/move-out service is designed for landlords, property managers, tenants, and homeowners. Ask us about photo reports and volume pricing for five or more turnovers a year.Ready for a cleaner homeand more peace?Join our waitlist for the January 2027 launch, or explore our limited holiday cleaning availability.Join the WaitlistRequest a Cleaning

/terms.h1: Mirembe Cleaning Company Terms of Service
/terms.mainText: Mirembe Cleaning Company Terms of ServiceLast Updated: October 25, 2026These Terms of Service ("Terms") are a binding agreement between you (the "Customer") and Mirembe Cleaning Company LLC (the "Company") for residential and rental property cleaning services. By booking our cleaning services, you agree to these Terms.IF YOU DO NOT AGREE TO THESE TERMS, PLEASE DO NOT BOOK CLEANING SERVICES.1. Acceptance and EligibilityBy booking our cleaning services, you confirm that:You are at least 18 years old, or the age of majority where you liveYou have the legal authority to give us access to the property to be cleanedYou have the legal capacity to enter into this agreementAll information you provide is accurate, current, and complete2. ServicesThe Company provides professional residential and rental property cleaning services. The specific services, scope, frequency, and pricing are confirmed at the time of booking. Services may include:Recurring home cleaning (weekly, biweekly, or monthly)Deep cleaningMove-in, move-out, and rental turnover cleaningAdd-on services as bookedThe Company may update its services and pricing at any time with reasonable notice.3. Service Scope and LimitationsUnless agreed to in writing, our services do not include:Cleaning at heights that require a ladder taller than 2 stepsMoving heavy furniture or appliancesExterior window cleaning above ground levelCleaning biohazardous materialsCleaning in hoarding conditions or homes with excessive clutterPest control or infestation cleanupCarpet shampooing or upholstery cleaning, unless bookedCleaning inside ovens or refrigerators, unless included in your service (such as our Deep Clean) or booked as an add-onThe Company may decline or stop service if conditions are unsafe or fall outside the agreed scope of work.4. Cleaning Supplies and ProductsThe Company provides all standard cleaning supplies and equipment. We use carefully selected products that are safer for your family, your pets, and your home, with fragrance-free options available. If you would like us to use your own products, please let us know when booking. You are responsible for how your products affect your surfaces.5. Payment TermsPayment is due according to the terms confirmed at booking.For recurring services, your payment method is kept on file and charged after each completed service.Weekend and holiday appointments may include a holiday rate, shown at booking.All fees are non-refundable except as stated in these Terms.The Company may adjust pricing based on service frequency, property size, condition, or additional services requested.A returned payment fee of $[25] may be charged for declined or returned payments.6. Scheduling, Cancellation, and LockoutsFree cancellation: You may cancel or reschedule at no charge with at least 24 hours’ notice before your scheduled service.Late cancellation fee: Cancellations or rescheduling requests made less than 24 hours before your scheduled service will be charged a $50 late cancellation fee.Lockout fee: If our cleaners cannot access your property at the scheduled time, for example because of a lockout, incorrect access instructions, or no one being available to let us in, a $50 lockout fee will be charged.Recurring services: Future appointments stay on the schedule unless you cancel them at least 24 hours in advance.Access instructions: You are responsible for making sure our cleaners can access your property at the scheduled time and for providing accurate access instructions, codes, or keys.Company rescheduling: If we need to reschedule because of severe weather, illness, or an emergency, we will contact you as soon as possible, and no fee will apply.7. Our Clean GuaranteeIf you are not satisfied with any part of your cleaning, please tell us within 24 hours of service, with photos if possible. We will return to re-clean the areas of concern at no additional cost. Re-cleaning is our remedy for quality concerns, and refunds are not provided for completed services.8. Property Access and KeysYou may provide the Company with keys, access codes, or other entry methods for your property.All keys and access information are kept secure and used only to provide the services you booked. Keys are labeled with a code, never your address.Please tell us right away if locks or access codes change.Keys are returned on request or when recurring services end.The Company is not responsible for locksmith fees if you are locked out of your property.9. Pet PolicyPlease tell us about any pets when you book.For everyone’s safety, please keep aggressive or unpredictable pets in a separate area during cleaning.Our cleaners may decline service or leave if they feel unsafe because of a pet’s behavior.You are responsible for any injuries to our cleaners caused by your pets.10. Damage and Breakage PolicyWe take great care in your home, but accidents can happen.Reporting: Please report any damage within 24 hours of your service, with photos and a description.Coverage: The Company carries liability insurance for damage caused by our negligence during service. Resolution is limited to the lesser of (a) the repair or replacement cost, or (b) the fair market value of the item.Exclusions:Pre-existing damage or normal wear and tearItems that are already damaged, cracked, or fragileItems that are improperly stored or unstableDamage caused by undisclosed property conditionsFine art, antiques, collectibles, or heirlooms, unless we agreed in writing to clean them with special careDamage caused by the Customer or third parties11. Theft PolicyThe Company conducts background checks on all cleaners and maintains strict hiring standards.Reporting: If you believe an item is missing after a cleaning, please contact us within 7 days of the service. We’ll check with our cleaner, help you look, and investigate right away.Formal claims: If the item isn’t found, theft claims require a police report, a copy of that report for the Company, and an opportunity for us to investigate. This allows us to file a claim with our bond.Exclusions:Cash, gift cards, securities, or cryptocurrencyJewelry, precious metals, or gemstones that were not securedItems claimed without proof of ownershipItems of sentimental value only, without a documented market value12. Your ResponsibilitiesYou agree to:Provide accurate contact, property address, and access informationKeep a reasonably clean and safe working environmentPut away valuables, important documents, and fragile items before serviceRemove or secure items you do not want moved or cleanedTell us about special concerns, fragile items, or areas needing extra careShare any property conditions that may affect service, such as pets, health concerns, or access issuesGive us notice of any changes to scheduled servicesTreat our cleaners with respect and professionalism13. Our CleanersBackground checks: All cleaners complete a background check before employment.Consistent cleaners: We make reasonable efforts to send the same cleaners for recurring services. We may send a substitute because of scheduling, illness, or other circumstances, and every substitute is held to the same standards and training.Tipping: Tips are appreciated but never required. You may tip cleaners directly or add a tip to your payment, and our cleaners keep 100% of their tips.14. Health and SafetyYour property: Please tell us about any health hazards in the home, such as mold, asbestos, or lead paint, and any contagious illness in the household. The Company may decline service or use additional protective equipment for hazardous conditions.Our cleaners: If a cleaner is ill, we will send a substitute or reschedule. Our cleaners follow the Company’s health and safety procedures.15. Insurance and BondingThe Company carries general liability insurance and a janitorial bond. Proof of insurance is available on request.16. Force MajeureThe Company is not liable for any failure or delay in providing services because of circumstances beyond our reasonable control, including severe weather, natural disasters, pandemics, government restrictions, or other emergencies. In these cases, we will reschedule your service at the earliest opportunity, and no fee will apply.17. Privacy and ConfidentialityWe respect your privacy. We do not share your personal information or details about your property with third parties except as needed to provide services or as required by law. Please see our Privacy Policy for details.18. CommunicationsBy providing your phone number and email address, you agree to receive messages about your bookings, including:Appointment confirmations and remindersService updates or delaysBilling and payment noticesRequests for feedbackYou may also receive occasional promotional messages. You can opt out of promotional messages at any time by replying STOP to texts or using the unsubscribe link in emails. Standard message and data rates may apply.19. TerminationBy the Customer: You may stop services at any time. For recurring services, please cancel at least 24 hours before your next scheduled service to avoid the late cancellation fee.By the Company: The Company may end services immediately for:Non-paymentUnsafe working conditionsVerbal abuse or harassment of our cleanersViolation of these TermsProviding false information20. Limitation of LiabilityTO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW:THE COMPANY’S TOTAL LIABILITY FOR ANY CLAIMS ARISING FROM THESE TERMS OR THE SERVICES WILL NOT EXCEED THE AMOUNT YOU PAID FOR SERVICES IN THE THREE MONTHS BEFORE THE CLAIM.THE COMPANY IS NOT LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, INCLUDING LOST PROFITS OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION.SOME STATES DO NOT ALLOW CERTAIN LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY, SO THESE LIMITATIONS MAY NOT APPLY TO YOU.21. IndemnificationYou agree to indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its employees from any claims, damages, losses, or expenses arising from:Your failure to disclose property hazards or conditionsInjuries on your property caused by conditions you created or did not discloseYour violation of these TermsFalse accusations against our cleaners22. Dispute Resolution and Governing LawInformal resolution: Before starting any formal dispute, you agree to contact the Company and try to resolve the issue informally for at least 30 days.Small claims: Either party may bring a claim in small claims court for disputes within that court’s limits.Governing law: These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Connecticut.23. Changes to These TermsThe Company may update these Terms at any time. For existing customers, we will email notice of material changes at least 30 days before they take effect. Continuing to use our services after changes take effect means you accept the updated Terms.24. SeverabilityIf any part of these Terms is found invalid or unenforceable, the rest of the Terms remain in full effect.25. Entire AgreementThese Terms, together with any service-specific agreement and our Privacy Policy, are the entire agreement between you and the Company about our cleaning services and replace any earlier agreements or understandings.By booking cleaning services with Mirembe Cleaning Company, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms of Service.Questions? Contact us at hello@mirembecleaning.com or 617-917-4137.

/privacy.title: Mirembe Cleaning Company Privacy Policy
/privacy.description: Read the Mirembe Cleaning Company Privacy Policy, effective October 26, 2026, covering service requests, applications, communications, and optional tracking.
/privacy.mainText: Mirembe Cleaning Company Privacy PolicyEffective date: October 26, 20261. Who we areMirembe Cleaning Company LLC (“Mirembe,” “we,” or “us”) is a family-owned Connecticut limited liability company providing home and rental property cleaning in Greater Hartford, Connecticut, and Greater Boston, Massachusetts.This policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect personal information when you visit mirembecleaning.com, join our waitlist, request or book a cleaning, apply to work with us, communicate with us, or receive our services in your home.2. Information we collectInformation you give usWaitlist: your email address and, if you choose, your ZIP code.Cleaning requests and bookings: your name, email, phone number, service address, home details (such as bedrooms and bathrooms), selected services and add-ons, preferred dates, and any notes you share. Payment details are entered only in our payment provider’s secure fields.Home and service details: information that helps us care for your home, such as entry instructions, keys, alarm or lockbox codes, parking, pets, priorities, surfaces needing special care, allergies or fragrance sensitivities, and, if you arrange cleaning for a loved one, a family contact who receives visit updates.Cleaner applications: your name, email, phone number, city and state, access to a vehicle, cleaning experience, languages spoken, travel distance, and availability.Messages: anything you share when you email, text, call, or message us. Please don’t send sensitive information we don’t need, such as payment card numbers or identity documents.Information created when we provide servicesService records: appointment dates and times, the services provided, notes about your visit, and any quality or damage reports.Photos: our cleaners photograph finished rooms for quality checks and our records. We avoid capturing mail, documents, family photos, house numbers, or other personal items, and we never post photos of your home publicly without your written permission.Information collected automatically on our websiteTechnical information: like most websites, our hosting and security providers process information such as your network address, browser and device type, pages requested, and the time of each request.Form security: our forms use submission identifiers, timestamps, and security checks to process requests, prevent spam, and avoid duplicate submissions.Optional analytics and advertising: only if you allow it, we measure page visits and certain actions on our site (see Section 8).Information from other sourcesJob sites: if you apply through Indeed or a similar site, we receive the application information you submit there.Background checks: for candidates who receive a conditional job offer, we obtain a background check report only after providing a separate disclosure and receiving written authorization.Public reviews: reviews you choose to post about us on Google or other sites.3. How we use informationRespond to cleaning requests, schedule and provide services, and confirm, remind, and update you about appointmentsAccess your home safely and follow your preferences and instructionsProcess payments, send receipts, and handle billing questionsCheck and improve the quality of our work, including follow-up after a clean and our clean guaranteeSend waitlist updates, booking announcements, and occasional promotions, which you can opt out of anytimeReview job applications, schedule interviews and paid trial cleans, and complete hiring stepsProtect our website and forms from spam, abuse, and errorsWith your consent, understand how our website is used and measure our advertisingMeet legal, tax, accounting, and insurance requirements, and resolve disputes or claims4. Bookings and paymentsOur booking form is provided by ZenMaid. It may appear on our website or open on a ZenMaid-hosted page, and information you enter is processed by ZenMaid to manage your booking. Payments are processed by Square. We do not see or store your full card number; Square handles payment information under its own security and privacy practices.Submitting a booking request does not confirm an appointment. We will confirm your date and time by email or text.5. Your keys, access codes, and homeWe know you are trusting us with access to your home. Keys are labeled with a code, never your address, and stored securely when not in use. Access codes and home details are shared only with the owners and the cleaners assigned to your home, and only to provide your service. When you end recurring service, we return your keys and remove access codes from our active records.6. Emails and textsBy giving us your email address or phone number, you agree to receive messages about your requests and appointments, such as confirmations, reminders, updates, receipts, and requests for feedback.We may also send occasional promotional messages, such as booking announcements and seasonal offers. You can stop promotional emails anytime by using the unsubscribe link in the email or contacting hello@mirembecleaning.com, and stop texts by replying STOP. Message and data rates may apply. Opting out of promotions does not stop messages about appointments you have booked.7. Cleaner applicantsWe use application information to evaluate experience, availability, transportation, and service-area fit, and to contact applicants about job opportunities. Our application does not ask for a resume, Social Security number, or bank details. We do not ask about criminal history on the initial application.Applicant information is stored in our application records and an internal spreadsheet that only the owners can access. If you receive a conditional offer, we will provide a separate background check disclosure and authorization form. If you are hired, your employment information is handled under our employee policies.8. Optional analytics and advertisingIf you allow optional tracking, we use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use our website and Meta Pixel to measure Facebook and Instagram advertising. These services may process your browser and device information, online identifiers, and the pages and actions described below, under their own privacy policies.With your consent, we measure page visits, interest in service details, clicks on booking links, views of the booking form, and new waitlist sign-ups. We do not put your name, email address, phone number, service address, or booking notes into the information we send to these services.If you decline, the analytics and advertising tools are not loaded, and you can still use every form on our site.9. Cookies, browser storage, and your choicesOptional analytics and advertising tools load only after you choose to allow them. You can change your choice anytime using the “Tracking preferences” link on our website. If your browser sends a Global Privacy Control signal, we treat it as a choice to decline optional tracking.Your choice is saved in your browser. With your consent, we may also temporarily store campaign information, such as which ad brought you to our site. A separate setting remembers if you closed our holiday promotion banner. If you withdraw consent, we stop sending new optional tracking information and clear the related stored data and known analytics cookies, but we cannot undo information already sent.You can also clear cookies and site data in your browser settings. Clearing data or switching devices may mean you need to make your choice again.10. Companies that help us operateWe use trusted service providers to run our website and business. They may process your information only to provide their services to us:Vercel: website hosting and processing of form submissionsSupabase: secure storage of waitlist and applicant recordsResend: confirmation emails and internal notificationsGoogle Workspace and Google Sheets: business email and organizing waitlist and applicant follow-upZenMaid: booking requests, scheduling, client records, and appointment messagesSquare: payment processingCloudflare Turnstile: security checks that help tell people apart from automated spamMailchimp: sending our email updates and managing unsubscribesIndeed: job postings and applicationsCheckr: background checks for candidates with a conditional offerGoogle Analytics and Meta: optional analytics and advertising measurement, only with your consent11. When we share informationWe do not sell your personal information for money. We share information only:With the service providers listed above, to operate our businessWith the owners and cleaners assigned to your home, to provide your serviceWith our insurance provider or bond company if needed to handle a claimWhen required by law, such as a valid subpoena or court order, or to protect the safety of our clients, team, or othersIf our business is sold or merged, with the new owner, who must continue to protect your informationWith your permission, such as sharing a review or photo you approveIf you allow optional advertising tracking, Meta and Google may receive online identifiers and website activity as described in Section 8. You can decline or withdraw this choice anytime.12. How long we keep informationWe keep information only as long as we need it for the purposes in this policy, or as required by law:Waitlist: until you ask to be removed or unsubscribe, or 2 years after our last contactClient records: while you are a client, and for 3 years after your last service, for billing questions, claims, and our recordsAccess codes and keys: removed from active records and returned when recurring service endsService photos: 12 months after the service, or longer if needed for an open quality or damage claimPayment and accounting records: 7 years, as required for tax purposesJob applications: 2 years after the application if you are not hired. Records for hired team members are kept as required by employment law.Copies may remain briefly in provider backups before they are deleted on those providers’ schedules.13. How we protect informationWe use reasonable safeguards to protect your information, including secure website connections, access limited to the owners and team members who need it, secure storage of keys and access codes, and security protections on our business accounts. No website or storage method is completely secure, so please never email payment card numbers or other sensitive information.14. Your privacy choices and requestsYou can contact us at hello@mirembecleaning.com to:Ask what personal information we have about youCorrect inaccurate informationAsk us to delete your informationStop promotional emails or textsChange your website tracking preferencesPlease include the name and email address or phone number you used with us so we can verify your request. We will respond within 30 days. We may need to keep some information to meet legal, tax, or insurance requirements, and we will tell you if that applies. Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights under state law. If we decline your request, you may reply to ask us to reconsider.15. Children’s privacyOur services and job opportunities are for adults 18 and older, and our website is not directed to children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has given us personal information, please contact hello@mirembecleaning.com and we will delete it. Please share information about children in your home only when it helps us provide a safe service, such as a nap time to work around.16. Other websitesOur website links to services such as ZenMaid, Square, social media sites, and job sites, which have their own privacy policies. Our tracking preferences apply only to our website. Some of our service providers may process information outside your state or country under their own safeguards.17. Changes to this policyWe may update this policy as our services change. We will post the updated version on our website with a new effective date. For important changes, we will also notify current clients by email.18. Contact usMirembe Cleaning Company LLCEmail: hello@mirembecleaning.comPhone: 617-917-4137
